name: frontier
notes: No crutches beyond a nudge and one retry. If this profile ever needs more, the loop has a bug — do not paper over it here. Note on retryOnce: at temperature 0 it re-sends a byte-identical request — it only pays where the failure was non-deterministic (provider-side sampling variance, transient serving glitches). If it never fires usefully, the honest edit is ["nudge"], not a bigger cascade.
